text: The project targets more than 220,000 hectares of improved water resources management and aims to support the livelihoods of roughly 380,000 rural households. It plans to establish 150 new WMCAs and enhance the performance of 230 existing ones. The project also includes the emergency reconstruction of the Bakkhali Rubber Dam and the construction of 110 km of climate-resilient farm access roads.

metadata.solution_name: Climate and Disaster Resilient Small-Scale Water Resources Management Project (CDRSSWRMP/SSWRM)
